_comment: Specialist discovery heuristics: per vulnerability class, WHERE to discover the parameters to test and WHAT tool/technique to drive. Derived from public multi-agent scanner methodology (generalized — no source brand).

classes.discover: every reflected param (URL query + form field) + JS template sinks (dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML)
every query param + hidden form fields + CSRF tokens (SQLi can live in token validation)
classes.test: blind_oracle (arithmetic id=1+0 vs id=1+1) + boolean/time inference

classes.discover: URL-typed params (callback, url, redirect, webhook, img, proxy, fetch) + webhook-verification callbacks
path segments (/users/123) + UUIDs + sequential numeric ids in URLs
classes.test: sibling_scan (differential IDOR attacker A → victim B)

classes.discover: file/read/path/include params (file, page, template, include, lang, path)
command/code params (cmd, exec, ping, host, ip, eval) + deserialization endpoints
classes.test: command injection i'''d / brace expansion + deserialization gadgets

classes.discover: XML upload endpoints + multipart forms + Content-Type: application/xml
classes.test: XXE file disclosure + SSRF via XML parser + blind XXE via oob

classes.discover: JWT patterns in URL params, body, cookies, localStorage, Authorization header (eyJ…)
JSON POST acceptance (Content-Type: application/json) + merge/deep-extend endpoints
Angular/Vue/React template sinks + {{ }} interpolation in reflected params
REST/GraphQL routes + method tampering (GET↔POST↔PUT) + GraphQL introspection
